query: INSERT INTO businesses.email_check (member_id, business_id, answer, answered_at) SELECT id, business_id, $3, $4 FROM businesses.team_member WHERE id = $1 AND business_id = $2 AND removed_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT (member_id) DO UPDATE SET answer = $3, answered_at = $4 WHERE businesses.email_check.business_id = $2
